source_text: Sicut per unum hominem peccatum in hunc mundum intravit et per peccatum mors, ita et per unum Iesum Christum gratia et donum in plures abundavit. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: As through one man sin entered into this world and through sin death, so also through one Jesus Christ grace and the gift abounded unto the many. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Sin came into the world through one man, and death through sin >> Bible:Romans 5:12]]. Far more [[the free gift by the grace of that one man Jesus Christ abounded for many >> Bible:Romans 5:15]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
